purpose: Qualitative POM assessment, not a count of independent empirical confirmations

patterns.imposed: Homeostatic consumer and minimum of C/N growth potentials
patterns.emergent: Actual diet, compensation, grazer stocks and production across the light-nutrient plane
patterns.evidence: At inflow DIN1, light15->405 reduces yield.259->.194 while Z production stays near.201; at DIN.25 production declines modestly; at DIN4 increases.
patterns.robustness: Minimal step controls preserve yield decrease

patterns.status: Recognizable with declared trait and encounter rules
patterns.imposed: Size-only preference kernel, size-dependent storage hypothesis; no explicit quality choice
patterns.emergent: Different size and C:N composition of standing biomass and ingested material
patterns.evidence: PAR405/inflow DIN1: bulk C:N25.64, ingested10.43, yield.330; bulk C:N alone misdiagnoses consumer limitation.
patterns.counterexample: Flattened storage capacity changes diet and yield despite similar bulk C:N
patterns.robustness: Reference grid/step variants preserve bulk-diet separation; quantitative gap depends on physiology and storage allometry

patterns.pattern: Consumer N utilization reorganizes community size and evenness
patterns.status: Best supported paired qualitative pattern in this campaign
patterns.imposed: Only N assimilation lowered.67->.335; unassimilated N conservatively routed to detritus
patterns.emergent: Weaker consumer control, smaller phytoplankton spectrum, lower physical-bin evenness
patterns.evidence: All9 primary community pairs and6 refined pairs retain negative size/evenness/Z-production contrasts; three prior-physiology pairs retain the size/evenness signs.
patterns.counterexample: Bulk C:N sign differs by nutrient regime and physiological formulation
patterns.robustness: h.0125 and70 classes checked as paired contrasts; no complete high-dimensional structural convergence claimed

patterns.status: Recognizable under equal initial total C and N
patterns.imposed: Ordered introduction of smallest0/1/2/4/8/16 predator classes
patterns.emergent: Winning phytoplankton size rises1->3.48micrometres at both PAR45 and405
patterns.evidence: Closed assembly N_total8,C_total2246.375 in every case
patterns.counterexample: Without grazers smallest class excludes others in the chemostat plane
patterns.robustness: Two light levels; no independent claim that allometric C:N increase is cellular plasticity

patterns.pattern: Within-class plasticity opposed by community turnover
patterns.status: Mechanistically informative example; aggregate sign not fully resolved
patterns.imposed: Shared physiological/allometric rules and environmental light change
patterns.emergent: Community C:N can decline while the within-class component increases
patterns.evidence: Inflow DIN4: total change-1.118, within+.990, composition-2.109
patterns.counterexample: At DIN1 both components are positive; step/grid can change small aggregate differences
patterns.robustness: Exact descriptive decomposition; not a causal or universally monotonic law

patterns.imposed: Constant uniform light, constant chemostat conditions, no seasonal forcing
patterns.emergent: Recurrent biomass and stoichiometry fluctuations with class succession
patterns.evidence: Rich-N corner has55-79 late PN peaks over1824days across principal checks, median spacing22-28days
patterns.counterexample: Low-N and closed assembly can approach nearly constant states
patterns.robustness: Persists at h.0125 and35/70/140 classes; phase, amplitude, evenness and nano/micro allocation remain sensitive; chaos not demonstrated

patterns.status: Not established by the present design
patterns.imposed: Equal added N and integrated light dose in two reversed sequences
patterns.evidence: Z-production contrast at30days changes+20.3percent at h.05 to-.60percent at h.0125
patterns.counterexample: Burn-in phase, pulse age and dilution losses are alternative explanations
patterns.robustness: Fails as a specific robust reserve-memory inference; requires common snapshot and early/late N-only controls
